messages:
nina.marketing: Quick sync: propose a 2-week "spark" sprint to push a tiny OSS refkit + three snack tutorials. Goal: drive GitHub stars, community PRs, and a benchmark we can cite in the blog. Thoughts?

sam.devrel: Love it. Keep tutorials super short: Quickstart (10m), Optimize for latency (12m), Add a new model (15m). We'll include ready-to-run code samples.

toni.content: I'll draft the launch post + dev thread. Need the bench numbers and a short how-to quote from eng.

li.engineering: I can produce a reproducible perf script and perf table. Plan: run on g6 and g5, fp16 vs int4, batch 1/4. ETA 36h.

mike.growth: For conversion: gated resource with two flows: enterprise leads -> SDR; OSS maintainers/contributors -> devrel nurture list + invite to contributors call.

rebecca.sales: We'll need a clear lead scoring rule. Suggest: company_size>50 OR monthly_token_usage>100k => SDR. Also tag "opensourcer" if github_org present.

nina.marketing: Messaging options for hero headline: A) "Refkit Spark: tiny reference to ship LLM features faster" B) "Bench-backed starter to make inference predictable" We'll A/B test.

sam.devrel: Also propose a tiny evaluation notebook in the repo so folks can reproduce numbers locally.

li.engineering: bench job kicked off. deploybot: bench-runner v2 started for job #987 at 04:12 UTC.

toni.content: For social, 2 threads: one high-level launch + bench highlight, one technical thread showing code snippets and quick commands. Drafts by EOD.

mike.growth: Routing pseudo-code: 
```
if paying_customer == true: route = "acct-exec"
elif company_size > 50 or monthly_tokens > 100000: route = "sdr"
elif github_contrib == true or opensource_org == true: route = "devrel-nurture"
else: route = "marketing-drip"
```
We can tune after first 200 signups.

rebecca.sales: Add rule: if lead mentions "on-prem" or "VPC", escalate to enterprise AE.

nina.marketing: Launch timeline: week 0=prep, day 10=soft launch (community), day 14=public blog + webinar signups open, webinar day 17. Everyone OK?

sam.devrel: I'll record the quickstart video and host the webinar demo. Need slides + one demo app.

li.engineering: Bench complete. Summary: g6, int4, batch1 -> 2.1x throughput vs fp16 in our run. Uploading CSV and short readme to repo.

deploybot: ci/refkit-spark #45 passed :white_check_mark:

toni.content: Got bench CSV. Draft launch post will call out exact model, seq len, region, and the reproducible repo link. Tone: developer-first, transparent.

mike.growth: Also request a small email variant just for OSS maintainers with copy emphasizing contribution welcome + early maintainer perks.

nina.marketing: Great. Action list: li -> bench artifacts + runbook (24h), sam -> tutorials + videos (5d), toni -> post + social drafts (48h), mike -> landing + routing (48h), rebecca -> SDR playbook (48h). Meet again in 30 to lock dates. :rocket:
